name: example-curl-field-hero
title: Curl Field Hero
description: Build a full-viewport curl-noise particle flow field — several thousand particles advect along a genuine divergence-free vector field, colored by a continuous cosine-gradient palette and organized by a slow orbiting attractor, under a spare editorial title-card overlay — rendered at 60fps as a single self-contained index.html.
credits: Curl-noise divergence-free flow field after Robert Bridson's curl-noise technique; original canvas implementation.
Additive point-sprite glow falloff inspired by pmndrs/drei Sparkles (MIT); reimplemented on canvas 2D.
Fluid vw-based type scale structure inspired by darkroomengineering/satus (MIT).

useCase.query: Build a full-viewport curl-noise flow-field hero as a single self-contained index.html: several thousand particles advect along a genuine divergence-free vector field (the curl of a multi-octave noise potential), colored by a continuous cosine-gradient palette, organized by a slow Lissajous-orbiting attractor that locally biases the flow — topped with a spare editorial kicker + oversized numeral title card.
